findings.what:
The '~1/6 lab->LB transfer' rule and the R4/R8 lab bar built on it ('+0.002 public = ~+0.012 lab'). IDEAS.md still uses the bar to discard every research-originated family (I-320, combo oracle). Its roots are v3 s_merge 'Lab gains transfer when the change does not lean on network confidence' and v3 (j)-16.
OLD VERDICT: the ratio came from ONE lever. The DaughterNet insertion had an in-sample exp60 lab of about +0.006 (44b6 +0.0058, 6bba +0.0065) and read +0.001 on the LB (probe 35), with the P28 pair (+0.0019 -> +0.001) in support (F-TRN-27 c9 'lab ratio ~1/6').
WHAT CHANGED: seven more lab/LB pairs since 25 Sep (cap 6, cap 8, cap 12+fc2, DC 0.30, CI, K, and 744093's truncation), plus the older probe-era pairs. Whole-history table, counting only non-zero LB reads:
- RIGHT sign, 5 pairs: P28 insertion +0.0019 -> +0.001; P35 insertion ~+0.006 -> +0.001; P48 CI bed +0.0032 -> +0.001; P50 K dummy +0.0013 -> +0.002; truncation -0.0050 -> -0.008 (other team's LB).
- WRONG sign, 9 pairs: P19 axis-flip +0.0214 -> -0.001; P21 relink off +0.0053 -> -0.002; P16 z-flip +0.0108 -> -0.009; P30 ef_a0 +0.0095 -> -0.001; P18 hygiene +0.0011 -> -0.001; P41 DC 0.30 (exp64 44b6 +0.0034) -> -0.005; P45 cap 6 -0.0006 -> +0.002; P49 cap 8 +0.0006 -> -0.001; P47 cap 12 fc2 (cap >= 8 arms +0.0006..+0.0019) -> -0.001.
- ZERO on the LB: DivNet +0.0023, lp30 +0.0008 twice, ef_a3 +0.0162, DC 0.20, forkmid.
Sign agreement is 5 of 14, below a coin flip. Among right-sign pairs the LB/lab ratio is 0.16-1.6 (median ~0.5), so 1/6 is the minimum, not the typical value. Six pairs had a lab gain >= +0.005: 1 read +0.001, 1 read 0 and 4 read negative. The +0.012 bar would have admitted only ef_a3, axis-flip and z-flip, all <= 0 on the LB. It rejects exactly the small structural gains (K, insertion CONF, truncation) that did transfer at ~0.5-1.6x.
NEW VERDICT: OVERTURNED as a rule. Lab magnitude does not predict the LB, and large in-sample lab gains are the artefact class. The only regularity is by class. Levers that act on every clip through geometry or the node set (truncation, K, and z shift / I-146 same-sign on both lab embryos) transferred in sign 2 of 2. Fork-set levers (caps, DC, hygiene) and edge-net or TTA levers went wrong 9 of 11; the 2 right ones are the insertion. The practical conclusion 'nothing research-originated is added on 29 Sep' STANDS for other reasons: the depth cap {K, SEC, DIS 2.25, CI}, no slot with a read before the 20:00Z finals, and R8. The one structural lab-positive closed item, the z shift +0.1 vox (+0.0016, both embryos +), stays post-deadline per R25-RC-B/R28-RC-A.

findings.what:
The finals rule in v2 FINAL_REPORT item 2 and v3 (f): 'Never pick the maximum public score among near-copies (winner's curse ~+0.0013).' Today the card does the opposite: V_pub = the highest display among COMPLETE files (CONTEXT l.3179), ties go to V* (R28-RC-B), and Q3 lets a SEC file be V_pub. Tomorrow up to 4 non-CI near-copies can compete: exp85a 0.958, exp89p (K+SEC), exp89q (K+SEC+DIS) and exp89s (K+DIS).
OLD VERDICT: the rule was derived under the '+-0.003 LB noise' model, where differences between near-copies were mostly noise.
WHAT CHANGED: (1) The noise premise is overturned (deterministic kernels, C-06), so a display step is a real public-embryo effect, up to rounding. (2) The public is one embryo. A lever's private effect is its public effect times an embryo-to-embryo correlation rho.
MEASURED rho proxy (exp60 lab, 44b6 vs 6bba deltas, 15 arms):
- fork-set levers: same sign 4, opposite 3, zero on one embryo 4; Spearman 0.27.
- geometry / node-set levers: same sign 3 of 3; Pearson 0.996.
MONTE CARLO (rounding-aware, vs exp85a's unknown unrounded value in [0.9575, 0.9585)), mc26 SEC prior (mean -0.0002, sd 0.0012):
- display 0.959 ('+'): E[private] = +0.12 / +0.34 / +0.66e-3 at rho 0.3 / 0.5 / 0.8.
- display 0.958 (equal): -0.15 / -0.11 / -0.06e-3.
- With a harsher prior (mean -0.0005), '+' gives -0.10 / +0.17 / +0.57e-3.
Max-display rule over the pool {exp85a, p, s, q}: E[private of the chosen file] is +0.07 to +0.69e-3, > 0 in all 9 prior/rho cells. Private realises ~25-70% of the public step (this is the curse, in size).
NEW VERDICT: the old rule was RIGHTLY RETIRED. 'V_pub = highest display, ties to exp85a' is +EV under every tested prior. A narrow form of the curse SURVIVES: a lever whose independent prior mean is <= -0.0005 and whose rho is fork-set-like (~0.3) has E[private | exactly +0.001] of about -0.1e-3, i.e. a coin flip. SEC n2a is closest to that corner: 0/6 own-weight LB swaps, dummy lab -0.0008..-0.0020 with the effect all on one dense clip, and one seed (RESULTS exp16 seed spread +-0.005). DIS (node-set class, R27 prior ~0) is not.

findings.what:
The v3 s_merge assumption 'Hidden test ~100-130 clips vs ~199' was left UNRESOLVED. v3 (i) dropped N2, the hidden-size bit probe: 'the information is almost free from latencies'. Plan text since then speaks of 'private = other embryoS', and the finals models (mc20/mc26) treat private lever effects as one draw with a fixed sd.
WHAT CHANGED: (1) Step 0 bounds N <= ~97-106 at dummy speed (I-002). (2) The public share is ~29% (CONTEXT l.9). (3) Discussion 743006 (12:27Z, unverified): 'two embryos in the hidden test set; the first one is private and the second is public (could be a mix split)'. The same thread says embryo = the id prefix. Together these make a SINGLE private embryo (~71% of clips) the most likely layout, not several.
Why it matters: lever effects do not average on private. The lab shows lever responses depend strongly on embryo type. Measured on the exp60 control, 44b6 has 11 GT divisions on 17 clips (0.65 per clip) and 6bba has 88 on 39 (2.26 per clip). Every fork-set lever reads exactly 0 on 44b6 (caps >= 6, nosteal, forkmid, DC 0.20, DIV 2.5). Geometry levers keep their sign but are ~3x larger on 44b6 (truncation -0.0131 vs -0.0043; z shift +0.0025 vs +0.0015).
NEW VERDICT: RESOLVED enough to act on the card wording. Treat private as one draw of an unknown embryo type. The two finals rows then hedge different embryo types:
- A {V_pub, #37}: the two files differ mainly in fork-set levers (cap 6, ILP division weight) plus READMIT. It pays on a 6bba-like private embryo; on a 44b6-like one the two files nearly coincide.
- B {V_pub, exp75}: adds CI, a geometry lever, whose effects are largest on a 44b6-like embryo.
So B's hedge spread is the larger-sd case of mc26: B beats A while the private CI mean is > ~-0.0004 at sd 0.0015, not -0.0002 at sd 0.0008. R28-RC-C's revised CI prior (central +0.0002) is above both. EXP75 PARTNER RULE v2 is UPHELD and slightly strengthened; nothing flips.

summary:
Round 29 recheck, 28 Sep ~20:25-21:10Z (23:25-00:10 MSK). Probe 51 was still PENDING. I skipped the 84 items rechecked in rounds 2-28, the 16 ideas_29sep candidates and the knobarms arms. An axis-flip re-read was dropped because I-151 already records probe 25. All numbers come from local records and two CPU scripts; there were no Kaggle API calls, and nothing was built, pushed, submitted or committed.
(A) The '~1/6 lab->LB' rule and the +0.012 lab bar: OVERTURNED as a rule. The whole-history table has lab/LB sign agreement 5 of 14. Lab gains >= +0.005 transferred 1 of 6, and the bar would have admitted only levers that read <= 0 on the LB (edge filter, axis-flip, z-flip). Structural every-clip levers (K, truncation) transferred at 0.5-1.6x, and cap levers had the wrong sign 3 of 3. The conclusion 'nothing new for 29 Sep' stands on the depth cap, R8 and the lack of read slots.
(B) v2/v3 'never pick the max public among near-copies (winner's curse)' vs today's 'V_pub = highest display': the old rule was RIGHTLY RETIRED. The rounding-aware Monte Carlo with a lab rho proxy (fork-set Spearman 0.27, geometry ~1.0) gives E[private of the max-display pick] = +0.07..+0.69e-3 > 0 in all cells, with private keeping ~25-70% of the public step. The one exception is a SEC file at exactly +0.001: about 0 in expectation. The card gets a note and shows {exp85a, #37} as the near-equal alternative.
(C) v3 'hidden test size/composition unresolved' + N2: with 743006 and the 29/71 split, private is probably ONE embryo. Fork-set levers read 0 on 44b6-like clips; geometry levers are 3x larger there. So pair B {V_pub, exp75} hedges a different embryo type than A {V_pub, #37}, and mc26's larger-sd break-even (-0.0004) applies. EXP75 PARTNER RULE v2 is upheld and slightly strengthened.
